segments.name: Greenstone GPA
segments.description: Holds a gold purchase agreement on the Greenstone Mine, receiving monthly gold deliveries which it sells.
segments.evidence: We earned revenue of $14.4 million from the sale of gold from the Greenstone GPA during the year ended December 31, 2025 as compared to $10.0 million in the same period of 2024.

segments.name: Blackwater royalty
segments.description: Holds a royalty on the Blackwater mine, which commenced production in 2025.
segments.evidence: We earned $1.2 million in royalty revenue from the Blackwater royalty during the year ended December 31, 2025.

segments.name: Kolpa stream
segments.description: Holds a copper stream on the Kolpa mine, receiving copper deliveries which it sells.
segments.evidence: We earned $3.9 million in revenue from the sale of copper received under the Kolpa stream during the year ended December 31, 2025.

segments.name: Kiaka royalty
segments.evidence: We earned revenue of $8.1 million from the Kiaka royalty during the year ended Dectember 31, 2025.

segments.name: Rosh Pinah stream
segments.description: Holds a silver stream on the Rosh Pinah mine, receiving silver deliveries which it sells.
segments.evidence: We earned revenue of $2.4 million from the sale of silver received under the Rosh Pinah stream during the year ended December 31, 2025.

segments.name: Santa Rita royalty
segments.description: Holds a royalty on the Santa Rita Mine, acquired in the third quarter of 2025.
segments.evidence: We earned revenue of $2.4 million from the Santa Rita royalty during the year ended December 31, 2025.

revenueModel.text: The company earns royalty revenue from mine operators and sells gold, copper and silver received under stream agreements, paying operators a percentage of delivered metal value.
revenueModel.evidence: Cost of sales represents a payment of 10% of the value of the copper delivered to Versamet on a monthly basis to the mine operator.

changes.text: In 2025 the company acquired the Kolpa stream, the Rosh Pinah stream and the Santa Rita royalty, adding new segments.
changes.evidence: No revenue was earned under the Kolpa stream in 2024 as the Kolpa stream was acquired during the second quarter of 2025.

changes.text: In 2025 the Blackwater and Kiaka mines commenced production, generating first revenue from those royalty segments.
changes.evidence: No revenue was earned from Kiaka in 2024 as the Kiaka Mine only commenced production in Q2 2025.
